supportCopy.normal_tension: This looks like normal tech tension. A family media plan or a simple reset may be all you need right now.
supportCopy.pattern_forming: A pattern is forming. A practical reset now can keep it from hardening into something harder to undo.
supportCopy.family_impact_loop: This has grown into a family-impact loop — multiple costs and limits that don't stick. A parent consult or therapist-informed plan is worth it.
supportCopy.support_recommended: This is the kind of pattern where support is genuinely recommended. You don't need to wait until things are extreme.

cta.title: You don't have to carry this alone.
cta.body: This is the kind of pattern that usually needs more than another screen-time rule. Blue Light CARES helps your child build other ways to regulate and reconnect, and helps you stop turning every limit into a fight.
cta.reassure: Therapy isn't a punishment for screen use. It's support for the regulation, avoidance, conflict, or connection pattern underneath it.
cta.lowReadyBody: When you're ready, Blue Light is here. You can save your result and come back anytime.
cta.safetyTitle: This needs more than a quiz.
cta.safetyBody: Some of what you shared points to a possible safety concern. Please reach out to a professional now. In the US you can call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) anytime, or call 911 in an emergency. Blue Light can also help you find the right support.
